notes: The final I Jehovah have spoken it clause is aligned as in EZK.21.17, derived independently.

Partition verified. Because תִּהְיֶה writes the copula itself, the resultative לְ keeps only its own *for* rather than a result frame (rule 49), and the fronted לָאֵשׁ is split into preposition, assimilated article and noun across the ASV's reordering (rules 12, 25). The supplied object *it* after have spoken is added under rule 44.
